name: python-observability
description: Python structured logging, metrics, tracing, and production debugging.

Use for logging, metrics, tracing, correlation IDs, dashboards, and production issues. Make logs machine-readable so teams can investigate without deploying code.

Production logs: JSON via `structlog` (`structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso")`, `structlog.processors.JSONRenderer()`, `structlog.get_logger()`); human-readable locally. Include consistent filtering/correlation fields. Use `structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars`, `structlog.processors.add_log_level`, `structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer`, and `structlog.processors.format_exc_info`. Levels: `DEBUG` diagnostics, `INFO` lifecycle/operations, `WARNING` recoverable anomalies, `ERROR` failures needing attention.

Generate a unique correlation ID at ingress; propagate through logs, spans, and downstream requests (e.g., `X-Correlation-ID`), and return it in the response. `contextvars.ContextVar` and `structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars` support propagation.

Track latency, traffic, errors, and saturation at every service boundary. Use `prometheus_client.Counter`, `Histogram`, and `Gauge`;
